service.description:
Runs a DeviceRequest on the driver of its connection: DeviceConnection.driverEnumId (DcdMqtt, DcdOpcUa, DcdModbusTCP, etc.), else the scheme of DeviceRequest.brokerUri or DeviceConnection.transportConfig (mqtt://, mqtts://, paho-mqtt5:?brokerUrl=..., opc.tcp://, modbus-tcp://). Set it as DeviceRequest.runServiceName, as moqui.plc4j.Plc4jServices.run#Plc4jRequest was; moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest calls it.
DrtRead reads the items and stores the values (DeviceAcquisitionServices.store#Samples). DrtWrite writes the values of the item Parameters; an MQTT write without items publishes the payload parameter as JSON on DeviceRequest.query. DrtSubscribe, DrtEvent and DrtStateChange subscribe, DrtCyclic polls at pollingInterval (an MQTT DrtCyclic subscribes); what arrives is stored through the sample queue. DrtUnsubscribe stops the subscription of parentRequestName.
The item address is DeviceRequestItem.query, else DeviceRequest.query: an MQTT topic, an OPC UA node id, a Modbus register. With the property device_gateway_device_id set, a device outside the scope of that gateway is refused (DeviceAcquisitionServices.get#GatewayScope).

parameter.name: payload
parameter.description: The message of an MQTT write without items.

parameter.name: status
parameter.description: completed, partial, active, failed, uncertain or unchanged.

service.description: PLC log events over MQTT: a DrtSubscribe or DrtEvent request whose topic (DeviceRequest.query) carries the log events of the moqui-plc LoggerFacade. An event with a source is stored as a ParameterLog of that Parameter, an event without one as a DeviceLog (DeviceAcquisitionServices.store#LogSamples). The loggerName of each event must be the deviceId of the request. DrtUnsubscribe stops it. Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName.
